headline: Stonecradle and Weathered Balances Shift; Mooring Gains Colonial Post
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has tightened from six Warden posts against three Colonial to five against four; Stonecradle has seen its neutral strongpoint reclaimed and now counts three Warden posts among six Colonial; and Mooring County shows eleven Warden posts and one Colonial after The Wind Hills changed hands. The Stlican Shelf is sharply divided, five Warden posts to four Colonial, with Thornhold the focus of the latest exchanges. Linn Mercy and Fishermans Row stayed all-Colonial after the earlier wire; Gutter stayed all-Warden; no fresh flips have moved those totals. Farranac Coast still lists two Warden posts against nine Colonial, and losses there are climbing, though strongpoint changes have been quiet. Marban Hollow still shows one Warden post against seven Colonial, with casualties accumulating. The heaviest casualty totals in the recent figures are in Stonecradle, Weathered Expanse, and Callahans Passage. The war remains unresolved.
